name: resolve
assumes: a KiCad design given as a .kicad_pro or a root .kicad_sch (a .net given directly is parsed as it is)
saved_net: <project>.net beside the project, read through the file reader
raw: the raw .kicad_sch reader run on the root schematic and its sheets; fails means it throws (a sheet it cannot parse, a construct it does not read)
kicad_cli: off when the kicadCli setting is false (the default for a file reader other than the local disk); works or fails when it runs
a named design variant is applied afterwards in every case, from the schematic's instance blocks
